### 2026-10-06 – # The Beginnings

**5h**

# The Beginnings
Started off with pretty simple stuff today. Got all the components in order and started wiring some stuff.

## List of Components
* **HX TF PUSH (U8)** - A push-push MicroSD Card slot for storage
* **HC-TYPE-C-16P-026W (U6)** - A battery charging module that uses USB

![Screenshot 2026-10-05 224402](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/ieVGAbzNTDQ2hSfqebW0QS3O6h11aJq7/bd4f9198b98e8c71eb97f77661c7f97870a9cfa8936bf9345a07421f840c2145.png)

-C
* **XC6220B331MR-MS (U5)** - A voltage regulation module so I don't fry everything
* **TP4056-MS (U4)** - Using this to split power everywhere
* **HS20HS072RX (U7)** - A display!
* **PCM5102APWR (U2)** - A DAC to make up for ESP's bad mono DAC
* **PJ-320A-4P DIP (U3)** - A 4 pin headphone jack
* **ESP32-PICO-MINI-02-N8R2 (U1)** - The brain of the iPod, microcontroller
* A bunch of resistors, capacitators, buttons, and switches

![Screenshot 2026-10-05 224429](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/hackclub-half-life/sessions/ieVGAbzNTDQ2hSfqebW0QS3O6h11aJq7/2f40c89fb78df0569acd0e715867a0a2a28aad2dfa1fc49b4c30d9608169329c.png)

### 2026-10-09 – # Update 5

**1h**

# Update 5
Had to move even more components because of limitations. Design rules were also getting too strict, so I changed clearance from 2.0mm to 1.5mm, above the JLCPCB 1.247mm. Rerouted, and came up with 0 DLC errors. Routing is officially complete then!!
